jer_durrell_curator.text: Welcome to Durrell. Gerald Durrell started the zoo here in 1959 and set up the Trust to save species from extinction. He wrote lots of books, and funded the zoo with them. Every animal here is part of a breeding programme.

The dodo on our logo is for the bird that nobody saved. Our job is to make sure the next one gets a better deal. We've pulled species back from the brink: the pink pigeon, the Mauritius kestrel, the Montserrat mountain chicken frog.
